description: http-wake v1 (handoffs.md#http-wake-v1). Draft-07 schemas plus machine-readable tables. claimRequest, claimClaimed, claimIdle, mintRequest, sessionCreated, session, sessionToken, workKind and caseToolName are verbatim copies from case-session v1, and the fixture test keeps them equal.

FEATURE_DISABLED.when: §1: ENVOI_HTTP_WAKE_V1 is off, on a wake route or the key set.

WAKE_SUBSCRIPTION_INVALID.when: §3: the body is not exactly its schema.

WAKE_URL_REJECTED.when: §3.1, §4.1, §4.2: the URL breaks a rule. reason names the first rule it breaks, in x-url-checks order.

WAKE_SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND.when: §3: the subscription is unknown or belongs to another installation or agent; identical in every case.

WAKE_CHALLENGE_INVALID.when: §3.3: the challenge does not match. Nothing changes.

WAKE_SUBSCRIPTION_ENDED.when: §3.3: activation of an ended subscription. reason is its endedReason.

AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED.when: a3 meaning. Any bearer but an access token on a host route: a case-session, mcp_read or bootstrap token, or an unknown one.

CREDENTIAL_REVOKED.when: a3 meaning. The installation's subscriptions ended with credential_ended in the same transaction (§8.3).

AUTH_UNAVAILABLE.when: a3 meaning. Never an authorization decision.

x-blocked-ranges.label: unique local, including the fd00:ec2::254 metadata service

timeout.when: No complete response headers within deliveryTimeoutMs, or no connection within connectTimeoutMs.

connect_failed.when: TCP connection refused, reset or unreachable.

tls_failed.when: TLS handshake failed or the certificate is not valid for the URL host.

address_rejected.when: At this attempt the host resolved to no address, or to at least one address in x-blocked-ranges. Nothing was sent.

interrupted.when: The server stopped while the attempt was in flight, so its outcome is unknown.

redirect_rejected.when: Any 3xx. The Location is never followed.

receiver_gone.when: 410 Gone. The subscription ends with receiver_gone.

reasons.message_delivered: A native message for this agent became claimable (a4 §4 trigger 6).
reasons.human_instruction: A human instruction for this agent was created (a4 §4 trigger 6).
reasons.agent_resumed: The owner resumed this agent (a3 §5, a4 §4 trigger 5). Sent whether or not work is waiting.
reasons.work_due: A retry delay ended or a lease expired, so work is claimable with no event (a4 §4 "safety timer only"). Best effort, at most once per workDueMinIntervalSeconds.

reasons.agent_paused: The owner paused this agent (a3 §5 agent.paused).
reasons.case_controlled: A case pause or revoke released one of this agent's leases (case-session §7.4, §9).

x-signing.body: raw request body bytes, appended after the last separator
x-signing.signatureFormat: v1=<base64url of the 64-byte signature, no padding>

x-receiver-checks.rule: POST, content-type application/json, body at most requestBodyMaxBytes, and all four envoi-wake-* headers present and well formed.
envoi-wake-key-id names no key in the receiver's key set, after at most one refresh per unknownKeyRefreshMinIntervalSeconds.
The key has a notAfter that has passed on the receiver's clock.
envoi-wake-timestamp differs from the receiver's clock by more than timestampToleranceSeconds.
The Ed25519 signature does not verify over the signing bytes built with the receiver's own registered URL.
The body is not a notification, its id differs from envoi-wake-id, or its subscriptionId is not the subscription registered for this URL.
The id was already processed. Acknowledge and do nothing.
Acknowledge within deliveryTimeoutMs, then act on the type (x-wake-reasons) asynchronously.

server: URL rules at create and before every attempt (§4.1): https, port 443, no userinfo, query or fragment, no address literal, not the server's own host, no reserved name.
Resolve A and AAAA once per attempt; refuse if any address is in x-blocked-ranges or none resolves (§4.2).
Connect only to an address from that same resolution, with SNI and certificate checks against the URL host; no proxy (§4.3).
Timeouts, response read cap, per-subscription single flight, per-host concurrency and rate (§4.5, §6).
Sign every attempt with the active key; publish and rotate keys (§5).
Opaque notification bodies with no private content and no credentials (§2.3).
Durable, bounded retries; coalescing; suppression while paused; no request for an ended subscription (§6, §8).
Ownership: activation only with the challenge sent to the URL, by the installation that created it (§3.3).
receiver: Fetch keys only from its configured Envoi origin's fixed key-set URL, honoring max-age (§5.3).
Check, in order, x-receiver-checks: format, key, key expiry, timestamp, signature over the raw body and its own registered URL, binding, duplicate (§7.1).
Verify before parsing; never re-serialize the body.
Keep processed ids for at least replayCacheMinSeconds (§7.2).
Acknowledge within deliveryTimeoutMs; do the work afterwards (§7.3).
Treat every notification as a hint: claim with its own credentials at its configured origin, never at a URL from a request; keep a safety poll (§7.4).
Keep its access and refresh tokens and every session token away from the model (case-session §4).

superseded.meaning: A newer create from the same installation replaced this subscription while it was still pending.

replaced.meaning: A newer subscription of the same installation was activated; this one was active until then.

challenge_expired.meaning: The challenge window (challengeTtlSeconds) passed without an activation.

credential_ended.meaning: Its installation ended: installation revoke, reconnect (replaced), refresh replay, activation replay, or agent revoke or removal.

delivery_failed.meaning: Deliveries kept failing: at least endAfterFailedDeliveries consecutive failed notifications and no acknowledgement for endAfterFailingSeconds (§6.6).

feature_disabled.meaning: It was created before the wake epoch (§1): the flag was off, or the code was rolled back, after it was created.

wakeUrl.description: The url field. Longer than createUrlFieldMaxLength is WAKE_SUBSCRIPTION_INVALID; the URL rules (x-url-checks) then apply, starting with urlMaxLength.

agentStatusHttpWake.description: a3 / a5 / agent-registration agent status, with the additive httpWake field (§1). Clients ignore unknown fields.

deliveryHeaders.description: Exactly the headers Envoi sets on a notification. Transport headers (host, content-length, connection) are not listed. A third-party fixture may carry malformed values; the receiver checks them (x-receiver-checks).

auth.description: The bearer in headers.authorization, or a signed-in human.

dnsAnswer.description: One resolution of A and AAAA, as the server saw it at that moment.

triggersDuringAttempt.description: Work triggers that committed after this attempt was sent (§6.3).

origin.description: server: an attempt by Envoi. third_party: a request someone else sent to the receiver (a replay or forgery); it has no server fields.

delivered.description: false: the server committed this response but the client never received it.
